limitations: This candidate transcribes seventeen Table 2 fields for the ten numbered analyzed animals only, including sex, cannula sizes, growth rate, terminal brain/body/organ measurements, and transfusion count; the four early deaths remain separate and are not assigned invented animal IDs or joined to Table 2 rows.

The Results state that nine animals ended protocol between 10 and 14 days except Animal 2, which was extended to 21 days; Table 2 lists Animal 5 at 16 days. Table 2 age-at-necropsy minus age-at-cannulation and the reported group mean support the 16-day cell, but this does not resolve the narrative discrepancy. Preserve both source statements.

Table 2 has no brain-weight or derived brain-ratio cells for Animal 3. Brain MRI and histology analysis counts are six each, but the three fixation exclusions are not linked to numbered animals. Terminal brain mass and weight ratios are not MRI, histology, or functional outcomes.
This experiment ended with terminal analysis after euthanasia and reports no post-support developmental follow-up. It is not evidence of long-term health or human gestation feasibility.

The source page identifies one 82.7 MB supplementary-figures PDF, 41390_2024_3287_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, described as “Supplemental figures_small animal-R3 paper.” Only page metadata was inspected; the file contents were not reviewed, so animal-specific plot traces remain unassessed.

Table 2 reports transfusion counts for the ten analyzed animals, and the Results state that six of ten required at least one transfusion. This care-exposure count is not itself an adverse-outcome measure and does not describe the four early-death animals.

Table 2 footnotes conflict with row-summary arithmetic: all ten displayed growth-rate cells reproduce 40.3 ± 5.4, although Lamb 1 is said to be excluded; excluding Lamb 1 gives 36.947 ± 4.719. For brain-to-liver weight, excluding the blank Animal 3 and the Lamb 5 outlier leaves a displayed-row mean of 0.50 (SEM 0.042), versus the printed 0.48 ± 0.04; the mean difference may reflect rounding of individual cells. Preserve all individual values and published summaries without correction.

The paper also reports five extremely preterm controls, ten historic late-gestation EXTEND animals, four late-gestation controls (with MRI/histology n=3), and a three-animal IUGR pilot. Table 2 comparison values for control/historic groups are aggregate summaries with no numbered-animal mapping or row-specific denominators; the IUGR pilot is explicitly excluded from statistical comparisons. These groups are represented only as cohort coverage here, not joined to the ten numbered extremely preterm EXTEND animals.
